title: Causal Ordering and Monotonicity in a Aether-Continuum Lamport Clock Implementation
topic: No Effect Before Its Cause: From Einstein to Lamport
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We investigate the causal ordering guarantees of a lightweight Lamport clock implementation in Aether-Continuum, focusing on the invariant that no effect can precede its cause. The design preserves monotonicity and causal precedence through local increments and remote updates, yielding a formally verified ordering relation. We present a theorem that any two events with a causal relation are assigned strictly increasing timestamps, and we prove this invariant using a simple induction over the event graph. Static analysis of the Aether-Continuum source confirms that the algorithmic complexity of increment, update, and timestamp retrieval is $O(1)$, while the overall structure satisfies the required asymptotic bounds for distributed event ordering. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Aether-Continuum-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261112_010253_no_effect_before_its_cause__fr}.
